title: E2 agent output (e2-format-tagger)
description: Spec 13/E2 'Agent output': {"format","new_description","confidence"} -- matching .claude/agents/e2-format-tagger.md's worked example exactly. The `format` enum is config/allowed_values.yaml v0.3's list verbatim, 19 values, generated from docs/question_categories/RULEBOOK.md section 2. THE SCHEMA DELIBERATELY DOES NOT CONSTRAIN format AGAINST THE STEM'S NEGATIVE WORDS -- that is spec 13/E2's negative-word guard, which needs B3's `negative_words_seen` and the parsed options, so it lives in scripts/checks/E2.py and is the one E check that can force an adjudication (E2_NEGATIVE_GUARD, high). A schema cannot express it: the same `format` value is correct or wrong depending on the question's options. `note` optional per Universal rule 7; `codebook_version` is the runner's to record, not the agent's (see schemas/E1.json).

format.description: What the student must PICK. Spec 13/E2's key test: look at the OPTIONS -- what kind of thing differs between them? Never how the question is built (that is E1). config/allowed_values.yaml format, v0.3.

new_description.description: One line, REQUIRED (non-empty) when format is new_format -- E_NEW_CATEGORY (normal) carries it to Stage F. Enforced in scripts/checks/E2.py.

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
